question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Summery: Maxim Gorky, born in 1868 in Nizhny Novgorod, Russia, was raised by his maternal grandparents who were passionate about literature and the poor. He left home at 12 and worked as an errand boy, dish washer, and icon maker. Gorky began writing under the pseudonym Jehudiel Khlamida and published his first book, Essays and Stories, in 1898, He lived on the island of Capri from 1906-1913 to escape Russia's repression.
